title: BitGo adds Jupiter validator as SOL staking option for custody clients
description: Eligible BitGo institutional clients can now delegate SOL from custody to a validator run by Jupiter, whose main validator holds about 9.72 million SOL.

title: Bithumb staff data leak prompts on-site inspections by Korean regulators
description: South Korean regulators opened on-site inspections at Bithumb on Oct. 28 after the exchange reported that abnormal outside access leaked employee data.

title: CFTC reopens probe into whether Polymarket broke its 2022 US-user settlement
description: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission is again examining whether Polymarket kept US users off its offshore platform, a year after earlier probes closed without charges.

title: Strategy shareholders approve daily dividends on four preferred stocks
description: Strategy shareholders voted on Oct. 28 to let STRF, STRC, STRK and STRD accrue dividends every calendar day, with payments on business days starting in November.

title: Liquid reserve gap narrows to 600 BTC after test transfer
description: A 2.53 BTC test transfer on Oct. 27 left Liquid's federation wallet about 600 BTC short of circulating L-BTC, and JAN3 CEO Samson Mow said the remainder will be covered within days.
